purpose: Semantic Adventure entrance library: ordinary surface doors, Central Route biome gates, Shifting Depth entrances, and mount sanctuaries.

selectionRules.surface-map:*: normal-biome-doors.png; three deterministic functional variants per biome
selectionRules.Central Route and biome returns: biome-doors.png; one monumental identity gate per biome
selectionRules.depth-entry:*, depth-link:*, depth-retur: depth-entrances.png; one dangerous subterranean threshold per biome
selectionRules.mount-sanctuary:*: sanctuary-entrances.png; one peaceful ceremonial threshold per biome

packAudit.finding: Contains many 16x16 top-down door and wall frames, but not a complete matching set of side-view full-height biome entrances.
Contains useful wooden, stone, barred, and metal door parts, but not a coherent three-door family for all eight biomes.
Standalone doors exist for Warped Caves/Emberdeep and Fort of Illusion/Tournament Gold; the remaining biome packs do not ship equivalent standalone doors.

generation.model: built-in image generation model; exact model version not exposed
generation.mode: generate from the existing project-owned biome gate atlas as a style reference; flat #ff00ff chroma-key background; soft-matte removal; nearest-neighbor frame normalization
